Bug_Title: All branches in a conditional structure should not have exactly the same implementation
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the code by using the same implementation for all branches of the conditional structure.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggered the bug by calling the `getBuggyValue()` method and asserting that the returned value is zero (0) in the first test case, and one (1) in the second test case. This triggered the bug because both test cases were expecting the same implementation for the if-else statement, which is not allowed by the rule.
